remarks: See www.23LocustLaneStamford.com for more photos, list of upgrades, floor plans, 3D, video and more. This hidden gem checks off all the boxes. Fabulous turn-key home with gorgeous kitchen, beautiful baths, wood floors, unique stone finishes and tons of entertainment space. CHECK. Amazing, fenced backyard with large deck, stone patio, covered outdoor kitchen and cute shed. CHECK. New Solar system provides tons of savings. CHECK. Tucked on a quiet, cul-de-sac street; yet just seconds away from Ridgeway and High Ridge stores, and restaurants, including the new Whole Foods. CHECK. A commuters dream. Moments to the Merritt Highway and 1-95. 2.5 miles from Stamford Station with Amtrak service and an express Metro North train to NYC in just 50 minutes. CHECK. Welcome to 23 Locust Lane, a move in ready 3 bedroom, 2 bath home tucked back from the street on .25 acres. Bright, open concept main floor with a chef's kitchen, a custom bar with more stunning stonework, a new gas fireplace and a gorgeous full bath. From the attached garage is a mud room with custom cabinetry also leading to the backyard oasis. Enjoy a large primary bedroom with a custom walk-in closet, a 2nd large bedroom, and a spa-like full bathroom. There is a spiral staircase leading to the 3rd bedroom. The lower level provides a family room space, laundry, and an ample wine closet. There is an entrance to the back yard from there too. What an opportunity to own a home which finally CHECKS all the boxes.
